s1.desc: a dim bedroom with a yellow wooden bed and a matching bedside table against a grey wall

spans.view: with a phone lying on the bedside table

beats.text: Polly lies in bed with the covers pulled up and a sleep mask pushed up on her forehead, glancing around with her eyes open
Polly closes her eyes and sinks down into the pillow as the blanket rises up to her beak
Polly lies still under the blanket with her eyes closed, the mask still up on her forehead
Polly reaches up with a flipper, pulls the sleep mask down over her eyes and turns her head on the pillow
Polly lies still on her side with the mask over her eyes, tucked under the blanket

spans.notes: camera locked through the shot: ECC on the headboard band (y0.18-0.40, x0-0.35) scale 0.9999 tx -0.1 cc 0.999 at every 8th frame f8-112; compare 0/116 headboard, bedside table and floor edges overlap. The phone on the bedside table shifts a few px once (f8-13, a small buzz). Phone is the iFin (pale grey back, lenses, tuft) but only lies there, so written 'a phone' in view. No overlay in top third or bottom fifth
13 frames: lights out, Polly lies awake with the mask pushed up, staring at the iFin held to her face, her face lit by its glow
